component.name: NexoLLM
component.summary: On-device AI autocomplete, writing tools and smart lookup for every app

description.p: NexoLLM sits quietly in your system tray and suggests the rest of your sentence right after the cursor. Every suggestion, rewrite, translation, summary, screen OCR pass and optional Whisper audio transcription runs 100% locally on your computer's GPU and CPU.

ul.li: Six active languages: English, Italiano, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português
Local llama.cpp + whisper.cpp inference with zero cloud dependencies
AES-256-GCM encrypted writing style and cross-app topic memory
Offline Ed25519 signature verification on all updates
